description: TeamRankings team stat table for NBA or NFL, for one stat page (for example points-per-game): rank, team, the season value, last 3 games, last game, home and away averages, and the previous season, as TeamRankings publishes them. Related tools on this server, for a different need: dev_fanduel when you need FanDuel Sportsbook game lines for NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, WNBA; dev_sportsline when you need SportsLine odds board: for NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, college. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

stat.description: Stat slug as in teamrankings.com/<sport>/stat/<slug>, e.g. points-per-game (default)

name: dev_teamrankings
title: TeamRankings team stat table for NBA or NFL, for one stat
